title: Open pullback Hom transport square
statement: Let $s:Y\to S$ be a morphism of schemes, $B\subset Y$ an open, and assume derived categories of sheaves of modules in the common Hom universe $w$ on every scheme [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-derived-category]. Put $L=\operatorname{schemeMVDerivedRestriction}(Y,B)$ [def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data]. Supply an adjunction $a:LB.\iota^*\dashv RB.\iota_*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback, lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. For $r:T\to S$, put $\pi_r:Y\times_S T\to Y$, $\pi'_r:B\times_S T\to B$, and let $b_r:B\times_S T\to Y\times_S T$ be the pullback map induced by $B.\iota$ and the identities. Thus $b_r\pi_r=\pi'_r B.\iota$. Let $\sigma:L\cong LB.\iota^*$ be the mate of the identity on the common right adjoint between $a$ and $\operatorname{schemeMVAdjunction}(Y,B)$. Define $\kappa_r:L\pi_r^*;Lb_r^*\cong L;L\pi_r'^*$ as $c(b_r,\pi_r)$, then the equality comparison of the preceding cartesian equality, then $c(\pi'_r,B.\iota)^{-1}$, then $\sigma^{-1}$ whiskered by $L\pi_r'^*$, where $c$ is the fixed counit-pinned perfectHomComposition [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. For derived objects $M,Q$ on $Y$ and $f:L\pi_r^*M\to L\pi_r^*Q$, put $\tau_r(f)=\kappa_r(M)^{-1};Lb_r^*(f);\kappa_r(Q)$. For objects $T,T'$ of $\operatorname{Over}(S)$ and an arrow $g:T'\to T$, the canonical Hom transport satisfies $\tau_{T'}(\operatorname{perfectHomMap}(s,g,f))=\operatorname{perfectHomMap}(B.\iota;s,g,\tau_T(f))$. No supportedness, bijectivity or finiteness hypothesis is asserted or needed. The Lean interface accepts a comparison family pointwise equal to the explicitly defined $\kappa_r$.

proof.text: Use import all PerfectHomTransport to reuse its proved private associativity and conjugated transport calculations cc_assoc, trTo_assoc, trTo_congr, and homMap_trTo. Prove the additional source-composition calculation trTo_comp_source from cc_assoc using its hom and inv components, functoriality and inverse cancellation. All helpers are proved, not new holes.

For h = baseChangeMap s g and k = baseChangeMap (B.ι ≫ s) g, prove b(T') ≫ h = k ≫ b(T) by pullback.hom_ext. The first projection follows from the supplied he equations and baseChangeMap_fst. The second follows from pullback.lift_snd and baseChangeMap_snd.

Define d(r,f) by transport along b(r) to the composite projection q(r) ≫ B.ι, then conjugate by perfectHomComposition q(r) B.ι. Apply trTo_assoc on the two paths around the cartesian square and trTo_congr to identify them. Apply trTo_comp_source to obtain d(T',perfectHomMap s g f) = perfectHomMap (B.ι ≫ s) g (d(T,f)).

Substitute κ(r) = κ₀(r). Expanding the displayed κ₀ shows its conjugated Hom map equals pullback(q(r)).map(σ.hom at M), followed by d(r,f), followed by pullback(q(r)).map(σ.inv at Q). Naturality of perfectHomComparison with respect to the two σ components and the preceding d compatibility finish the assertion. Only the stated restriction functor and adjunction are used; no push-pull representing cocone or perfectness result is needed.

theorem perfect_hom_open_transport_square
    {S Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ S) (B : Y.Opens)
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (a : derivedPullback B.ι ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage B.ι)
    {T T' : Over S} (g : T' ⟶ T) (M Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (f : (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s T.hom)).obj M ⟶
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst s T.hom)).obj Q) :
    let b (r : Over S) :=
      pullback.map (B.ι ≫ s) r.hom s r.hom B.ι (𝟙 r.left) (𝟙 S) (by simp) (by simp)
    let σ : schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B ≅ derivedPullback B.ι :=
      (conjugateIsoEquiv a (schemeMVAdjunction Y B)).symm (Iso.refl _)
    let he (r : Over S) :
        b r ≫ pullback.fst s r.hom = pullback.fst (B.ι ≫ s) r.hom ≫ B.ι := by
      simp [b, pullback.map]
    let κ₀ (r : Over S) := perfectHomComposition (b r) (pullback.fst s r.hom) ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ derivedPullback f) (he r)) ≪≫
      (perfectHomComposition (pullback.fst (B.ι ≫ s) r.hom) B.ι).symm ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerRight σ.symm (derivedPullback (pullback.fst (B.ι ≫ s) r.hom))
    ∀ κ : (r : Over S) →
        derivedPullback (pullback.fst s r.hom) ⋙ derivedPullback (b r) ≅
          schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B ⋙ derivedPullback (pullback.fst (B.ι ≫ s) r.hom),
      (∀ r, κ r = κ₀ r) →
    (κ T').inv.app M ≫ (derivedPullback (b T')).map (perfectHomMap s g f) ≫
        (κ T').hom.app Q =
      perfectHomMap (B.ι ≫ s) g
        ((κ T).inv.app M ≫ (derivedPullback (b T)).map f ≫ (κ T).hom.app Q)
